versions.changelog:
Initial release of zotero-scholar-finder:

- Allows saving paper metadata, PDF links, and AI-generated summaries directly to your Zotero library.
- Requires ZOTERO_CREDENTIALS environment variable in userid:apiKey format.
- Provides command-line interface for adding paper details such as title, authors, URL, abstract, summary, and tags.
- Includes usage examples and parameter explanations for easy setup and operation.
